name: File With Uncommon Extension Created By An Office Application
description: Detects the creation of files with an executable or script extension by an Office application.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:(*\\excel.exe OR *\\msaccess.exe OR *\\mspub.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\visio.exe OR *\\winword.exe)) AND (file.path:(*.bat OR *.cmd OR *.com OR *.dll OR *.exe OR *.hta OR *.ocx OR *.proj OR *.ps1 OR *.scf OR *.scr OR *.sys OR *.vbe OR *.vbs OR *.wsf OR *.wsh))) AND (NOT (file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\assembly\\tmp\\* AND file.path:*.dll)) AND (NOT (((file.path:*C\:\\Users\\* AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Office\\* AND file.path:*\\WebServiceCache\\AllUsers*) AND file.path:*.com) OR (process.executable:*\\winword.exe AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\webexdelta\\* AND (file.path:(*.dll OR *.exe)))))
